notes.title: 🚀 Upcoming Features & Exciting Updates!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613259/462c13870f3ab890c071b82c045a158b7f18c645.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613259/7fbd081ff1eb4bfb6a8a525f7322236828c296b7.png[/img][/url]
Dear players and community,

We’re excited to announce some major additions coming soon to the game:

🎮 New Movement Mechanics

Crouch & mantle system for smoother, more immersive navigation.

🛠️ Expanded Arsenal

Introducing new weapons like the crowbar and more to come!

🗺️ New Maps & Events

Explore fresh environments packed with challenging puzzles and unique events.

🧩 Strategic Gameplay

Solve environmental puzzles by manipulating objects and finding clever ways to progress. Every obstacle requires thought and creativity.

Thank you for your continued support! Stay tuned for more updates as we keep improving your experience.

— The Beveky Games Team
